# gtm_folder_entities (Data Source)

List all entities in a GTM Folder.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) GTM Folder's API relative path.

### Optional

- `all_pages` (Boolean) Follow next_page_token until every page has been retrieved. Defaults to true.
- `page_token` (String) Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.

### Read-Only

- `next_page_token` (String) Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.
- `tag_json` (String) The list of tags inside the folder.
- `trigger_json` (String) The list of triggers inside the folder.
- `variable_json` (String) The list of variables inside the folder.
